# NMC Hospital Fujairah

> NMC Hospital Fujairah is a private multi-speciality hospital serving Fujairah city and the surrounding east coast of the United Arab Emirates. Operating under the NMC Healthcare brand, one of the country's largest private healthcare networks, it offers outpatient clinics, inpatient wards, diagnostic imaging, laboratory services and emergency care. It complements the emirate's government hospitals and draws patients from across the Eastern Region. This staff accommodation building in Fujairah houses medical and support personnel working at a private hospital in the city. Purpose-built residential blocks of this kind are common across the United Arab Emirates healthcare sector, providing single and shared rooms together with communal dining, laundry and recreation space. Siting the building close to the hospital keeps staff within a short commute of shift work.

## Project Overview

- Category: Advanced Technical Facilities
- Location: Fujairah, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

NMC Hospital Fujairah is a private hospital operated by NMC Healthcare, serving patients across Fujairah and the UAE's east coast. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the hospital for NMC, with Consultair Engineers & Consultants as consultant. The project reflects MENASCO's capability in delivering building services for healthcare facilities with demanding operational requirements. This staff accommodation building was developed for NMC Hospital in Fujairah to house the hospital's personnel close to their workplace. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the building for NMC Hospital, with Horizon International as consultant. The project complemented MENASCO's MEP works on NMC Hospital Fujairah itself, extending its support to the healthcare provider's east coast operations.
